design_condition: The building sits between the tree line on the steep slope and the open river landscape, reshaping the surrounding outdoor spaces while connecting park and street through an open ground-floor passage.

positive.statement: The relaxed placement deals convincingly with the difficult context and leads into the open landscape.
The open passage convincingly integrates the building into the existing path system.
The enlarged staircase cores guarantee escape and create added value as a learning landscape.
The clear horizontal organization offers interesting usage options between the two staircases.
The building is independent but unpretentious and does not compete with the existing complex.
The structured common areas and directly connected group rooms support cross-class work.
The existing green strip creates a natural separation between play and break areas.
The clear building structure is easy to implement and meets the ECO requirements.

negative.statement: The prominent location of the archive and technical rooms next to the passage is not convincing.
The economic effort of the structural concept seems considerable.
Daylight is limited in the core.
Natural ventilation on the ground floor is not solved by the huge window sashes.
The vertical connection from the ground floor through the floor duct is unfavorable.
The ECO suitability, especially regarding materialization, is not documented.
Summer comfort is reduced in the sun-exposed corner rooms.
